text:
olivia: fyi, running into a strange browser-only SSE parse failure in sampleapp (v0.10.2 chrome). looks like chunks get merged and the browser parser sees a stray leading 0xEF byte before the JSON payload, which makes the SDK JSON.parse throw.

ton y: gross. 0xEF sounds like UTF-8 BOM. are we accidentally prepending a BOM during a flush/concat?

olivia: i thought so too but tcpdump shows the server emitted `

data: {"delta":"hi"}

` then after auth rotate we emit `data: {"delta":"there"}

`. however in the browser devtools network stream the combined view is `data: ï,{"delta":"there"}` — so some middlebox (or chrome) is merging a partial 3-byte sequence with the next write.

kevin: do we gzip SSE responses on that path? gzip + proxy buffering can smash chunk boundaries.

olivia: yes nginx had gzip on and X-Accel-Buffering wasn't set. disabling gzip on that location fixed it locally.

anya: we should prefer `X-Accel-Buffering: no` and `Content-Type: text/event-stream;charset=utf-8` and also explicitly flush a `
` delimiter before swapping tokens. docs already mention this but sampleapp doesn't set the header.

[dev-bot]: alert: staging deploy 2791122350 rolled out.

tony: recommend two changes: 1) sampleapp add SSE middleware that sets `X-Accel-Buffering: no` + disables gzip for `/events`. 2) sdk-parser be more defensive: strip leading UTF-8 BOM and any ASCII control characters before attempting JSON.parse of the data field. behind feature flag.

kevin: agree on middleware. for parser, add a safe-parse helper that searches for first `{` and tries parsing from there, logging metric `sse.parse_trim` when we had to trim. keep opt-in.

olivia: i'll open a tiny PR to sampleapp and a separate one to SDK with infra tests. i'll include a puppeteer-based e2e that reproes in headful chrome and asserts no parse exceptions for 1k runs.

anya: add a troubleshooting note to onboarding: if devs see sporadic parse failures, check proxies for gzip/buffering and ensure `Connection: keep-alive` vs `close`. also mention `Last-Event-ID` handling when reconnecting mid-burst.

tony: file ticket INF-4901 to track and prioritize. include tcpdump and nginx config snippet.

olivia: filed INF-4901 and linked the pcap + nginx snippet. will follow up with PR links. thanks!
